model.scope: Activate one Python pair manifest for one exact entry in the digest-bound bounded-Python recipe registry.
model.assembly: Validate the registry, selected entry, manifest, plan, observation, environment, parser, author, recipe-specific verifier, writer, and rollback capsules; author exact candidates; narrow explicit host activation authority into the exact candidate-bound edit authorization; invoke the existing durable pair Hand.
model.authority: The plane consumes explicit single-activation host authority. It cannot create that authority, broaden it, change recipe parameters after approval, or activate a generic model-authored candidate.
model.failure: Missing or mismatched manifest, recipe applicability, environment, authority, project state, parser, verifier, writer, or rollback evidence holds. Underlying post-mutation failure follows the durable writer's rollback/recovery result.
